title: Compute particles
description: The CPU writes the particles once. A compute pass then updates that same GPU buffer every frame, and the render pass draws it directly as an instanced vertex buffer, with no CPU readback in between.
unavailable: WebGPU is not available in this browser.

shaderHelp: The compute shader moves particles and bounces them at the boundaries. The render shader reads the same buffer as instance data and draws one disk per particle, with no CPU copy between passes. The WGSL below is the actual compiled code.
